· Work with business stakeholders to determine and document project high level business requirements (BRS) and obtain sign-off

· Set acceptance criteria for delivery cards
· Perform and own the data mapping activities
· Support business process design and system analysis
· Support Tech Lead as required on data modelling activities
· Transfer business knowledge to delivery and support teams
· Support Delivery Owner in prioritisation
· Support Developers / Testers / Analysts in delivery and support business stakeholders in UAT

Key Accountabilities:

· Support process of Business context and Requirements gathering
· Undertake technical analysis; define and document business logic; mapping and governance and success criteria
· Attend and contribute to agile ceremonies – Iteration Planning/Stand-up meetings/Retrospectives/Showcases
· Facilitate elaborations sessions; attend and facilitate other workshops as necessary
· Support development and testing team in understanding of requirements
· Contribute to Knowledge Transfer as required during and after delivery of project
· Perform other duties as necessary during delivery of project and as assigned by Project/Iteration manager
· Work collaboratively maintaining ongoing dialogue and relationships with Stakeholders as part of continued solution development and support.

Internal Relationships

· Develop and maintain positive working relationships with business customers.
· Work collaboratively with solution design peers and other technical peers.
· Work collaboratively with other internal areas (other parts of IT) as required.

External Relationships

· Work with external partners/vendors as required

· Project lifecycle experience (mandatory)
· Track record of working in a fast-paced collaborative cross-functional environment (desired)
· Proficiency in working with distributed teams (desired)

Key Capabilities/Technical Competencies (skills, knowledge, technical or specialist capabilities)

· Ability to analyse customer requirements and provide innovative solutions or alternatives to meet those requirements.
· Strong SQL, Data Analysis and Data Profiling skills
· Familiarity with Data Modelling and Data Warehouse concepts
· A disciplined approach to planning, implementation and project execution
· Excellent presentation and communication skills
· Sound change management skills
· Ability for both ‘technical speak’ and ‘business speak’ and able to translate one to another.

· Knowledge of Business Process Modelling and associated tools.
· Knowledge of a variety of database platforms, e.g. Netezza, Oracle, DB2, etc
· Knowledge of applications support and development
· Ability to cope with pressure, prioritise workloads and meet agreed timeframes
· Good knowledge of Insurance domain (Desired)
· Experience with Cloud applications (Desired)

result.description:
Store Manager

Are you a seasoned retail professional looking to take charge of a high-performing supermarket team?

Air Voice Supermarkets Pty Ltd operates a busy a community-oriented IGA supermarket focused on delivering quality products, strong customer service, and a convenient shopping experience. The business places importance on supporting the local community while offering fresh, affordable groceries every day.

An opportunity is available for a driven and capable Store Manager to lead the team and support the ongoing success and growth of our IGA store.

Location: Esperance, WA 6450
Salary: $80,000 to $86,000 per annum plus superannuation
Employment Type: Full-time, permanent

Key Responsibilities

•	Manage daily store operations to ensure smooth and efficient performance 
•	Track sales, margins, and expenses to meet financial targets 
•	Prepare sales projections and oversee budgeting 
•	Lead, support, and motivate staff to maintain high operational and customer service standards 
•	Execute promotional campaigns and merchandising in accordance with IGA guidelines 
•	Oversee pricing, stock management, and inventory control 
•	Ensure consistent availability of fresh and grocery items across all departments 
•	Maintain accurate records and ensure compliance with company policies 
•	Establish and enforce store procedures, including health and safety requirements 

Requirements

•	Minimum of one year full-time (or equivalent part-time) experience in a comparable retail management role 
•	A Diploma or higher qualification in Business, Management, Commerce, Marketing or Accounting or another relevant, or an additional year of relevant experience 
•	Demonstrated leadership, organisational, and communication abilities 
•	Capacity to handle competing priorities in a fast-paced supermarket setting 
•	Availability to work weekends, public holidays, and peak periods


How to apply:

Applications open on 27 July 2026 and close on 26 August 2026

Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Project Manager New Women's and Children's Hospital Project - Pool





Job no: 943518

Work type: Full time

Located in: Adelaide CBD

Categories: Administration, Business and Management




 

Department for Health and Wellbeing - Corporate & Infrastructure

Salary: $102,171 to $108,071 - ASO6 - Full Time - Term Contract up to 12 Months 

Do you want to be part of South Australia's largest and leading health infrastructure project?

The State Government is committed to building a bigger and better hospital for South Australian women, babies, children, young people, and families.

The multi-billion dollar, once in a generation, project will provide a new modern facility for our future communities by 2031.

Located in the Adelaide BioMed City precinct, it will have more beds, theatres, and greater emergency capacity - and increased scope for future expansion.

Healthy environments are an important element of the project as we set out to build one of the first all-electric public hospitals in Australia.

Set in Adelaide's iconic parklands, the site will provide people with a connection to Kaurna country and allow our dedicated clinical staff to provide a therapeutic approach to patients to enhance their recovery and wellbeing.

Overview:

The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating and undertaking the planning, delivery and review of complex healthcare related building projects and programs to time, cost and quality and ensuring projects meet the objectives and requirement of the government and Agency.

The role coordinates, undertakes and reviews project and subproject related scheduling, reporting, technical, financial, procurement and administrative functions to ensure established goals are met and develops and implements related procedures, standards, reviews and reports associated with the New WCH Project.

The Project Manager provides expert building project-program advice; identifies, advises on and resolves complex project risks and issues, and undertakes a range of procurement activities including the preparation of contract documentation and reporting.

SA Health is committed to providing an inclusive workplace that embraces diversity and inclusion for all employees. We strongly encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent, culturally diverse backgrounds, members of the LGBTIQA+SB community and people who live with disability and-or neurodivergence.

We are committed to making workplace adjustments to provide a positive and supportive work environment. You are encouraged to let us know if you have any support or access requirements during the recruitment process and beyond to ensure you can perform at your best.

The South Australian public sector promotes diversity and flexible ways of working, including part-time arrangements. Applicants are encouraged to discuss the flexible working arrangements for this role.

Appointment will be subject to a satisfactory Criminal History Check and appropriate immunisation requirements.

Job ref: 943518

A 'National Police Certificate' NPC (also known as a 'Nationally Coordinated Criminal History Check' NCCHC) for employment involving no contact with vulnerable groups is required for this position (general employment)

Immunisation Risk for this position is Category C (minimal patient contact)

SA Health Services are required to implement the Addressing vaccine preventable disease: Occupational assessment, screening and vaccination policy in the workplace.

Smart Hill Constructions Pty Ltd 
(Reso Scaffold)
16 Prospect Place, Boronia VIC 3155

Full Time Architectural Draftsperson
$95,000 + superannuation

Summary
Smart Hill Construction Pty Ltd, trading as Reso Scaffold, is a growing construction company specialising in residential, commercial and industrial building projects. As the business continues to expand its design-and-construct capability, the company requires an experienced Architectural Draftsperson to prepare detailed architectural documentation, support project planning and coordinate technical drawings throughout the construction process.

Our Architectural Draftsperson will be responsible for preparing architectural drawings and construction documentation, interpreting design concepts, coordinating technical information and supporting the delivery of residential and commercial construction projects. The position provides specialised drafting support across the business and contributes to efficient project delivery, design coordination and regulatory compliance.

Duties and Responsibilities

Design Documentation and Drafting
•	Prepare architectural drawings, plans, elevations, sections and detailed construction documentation using CAD, Revit and BIM software
•	Translate architectural concepts, sketches and design specifications into accurate technical drawings for construction purposes
•	Revise and update drawings to reflect design changes, engineering requirements and client variations throughout project deliver

Project Documentation and Coordination
•	Prepare documentation required for planning approvals, building permits and construction documentation packages
•	Coordinate architectural drawings with structural, civil, mechanical and other consultant documentation to minimise design conflicts
•	Maintain project drawing registers, revision histories and document control throughout each stage of construction

Technical Design Support
•	Interpret building codes, Australian Standards and planning requirements when preparing architectural documentation
•	Assist with material selections, construction detailing and specification preparation to support project outcomes
•	Produce 3D models, presentation drawings and visual representations where required to assist project coordination and client communication

Stakeholder Liaison
•	Liaise with Architects, engineers, project managers, consultants and clients to clarify design requirements and technical information
•	Coordinate drawing revisions and technical documentation arising from project meetings and consultant feedback
•	Support communication between design and construction teams to facilitate efficient project delivery

Quality Assurance and Compliance
•	Review drawings to ensure accuracy, completeness and compliance with project specifications and applicable regulations
•	Maintain drawing standards, templates and documentation procedures in accordance with company quality systems
•	Assist in resolving design documentation issues during construction and support continuous improvement of drafting processes

Assessment Criteria
•	A relevant qualification in Architectural Drafting, Building Design, Architectural Technology, Architectural Interior Design or a closely related discipline, or relevant industry experience
•	At least three years of relevant experience preparing architectural drawings and construction documentation for residential and/or commercial building projects
•	Demonstrated proficiency using computer-aided drafting software such as AutoCAD, Revit or other comparable CAD/BIM platforms
•	Experience preparing and revising floor plans, elevations, sections, construction details and other technical documentation
•	Ability to interpret architectural concepts, engineering drawings and technical specifications and translate them into accurate construction documentation
•	Ability to communicate and coordinate drawings with architects, engineers, consultants and construction personnel throughout project delivery
•	Understanding of construction methods, building materials and document control procedures
•	Experience managing drawing revisions, version control and project documentation
•	Strong attention to detail with the ability to produce accurate and high-quality technical drawings
•	Well-developed communication and organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines
•	Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with all levels of stakeholders


How to apply:

Applications open on 13 July 2026 and close on 12 August 2026 

Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.
